Transformers: More Than Meets the Eye is Elliot Eismin’s first pinball machine as lead designer and the first machine to be based on the original G1 incarnation of the Transformers franchise. The machine features a unique layout that rewards players who can consistently make difficult shots on the fly. Many of the shots can be hit from either flipper, so don’t be afraid to try a backhand even if it doesn’t look feasible.

sections.title: Skill Shots
sections.html:
Short plunge the ball to the upper flipper, then hit any shot from the upper flipper to score a skill shot and extend the ball save timer.

  • Optimus / standup target - scores 500k and +5 second ball save
  • Side ramp - scores 5M and +8 second ball save
  • Space bridge - scores 8M and +10 second ball save

There is also a secret skill shot: short plunge to the lower right flipper, hit the left orbit where Grimlock is, then make any of the three shots listed above from the upper flipper. The highest secret skill shot value is 15M for hitting the side ramp or the space bridge this way.

sections.title: Main Modes
sections.html:
In the search for Energon, the Autobots and Decepticons have crash landed on Earth. 4 million years later, the robots have reawakened. The Decepticons plan to pillage Earth’s energy sources, while the Autobots must protect the new world they have been sent to at all costs.

Transformers: More Than Meets the Eye features two sets of main modes, which can both run at the same time and brought into multiball modes as described below if a mode is started before the multiball.

children.title: Missions, Energon & Cosmic Rust
children.html:
Knock down the drop targets in front of Megatron, then shoot the scoop behind them to start the currently flashing mission. The first two missions of a game require one shot to Megatron’s scoop to start, but the remaining missions require three shots. Clearing all three of the drop targets in front of Megatron will count as one shot towards the next mission, but won’t start it. Mission selection, shown on the lower playfield inserts, can be cycled using the flippers. The drop targets in front of Megatron only reset if the player hits all three before shooting Megatron’s scoop. Hitting Megatron while only the center drop target is lowered, or all drop targets are raised, scores a 5M Megatron Trickshot award.

There are five different missions to play through, timed for 60 seconds, that light different shots on the playfield for progress, with a final blow available at Megatron if the player makes enough lit shots. Increase the final blow by 1M by hitting Megatron’s scoop at any time in the mission (so long as it isn’t currently lit). The player doesn’t need to make the final blow to “complete” the mission, only make the required shots before time runs out. Once the timer is below 15 seconds, shooting Optimus will reset the timer to 20 seconds, once per mode, and only if final blow isn’t already lit. Lighting final blow will automatically add time to the current mode as compensation.

The final blow is worth 35% of the score from the completed mission by default. Energized missions score 20%, while rusted missions score 50% of the total. Shooting Megatron during a mission adds +5% to the final blow value, and an additional 10% of the value is added if the mission is completed on the first try.

Scoring the final blow of any mission will apply a 2x shot multiplier to a random shot on the playfield, that only activates when a tech spec is lit to collect at that shot. Playing (not necessarily completing) two missions lights the right ramp to start One Shall Fall, while completing all five missions lights the VUK for Rescue Optimus mini-wizard mode.

If the player fails a mission by draining before time runs out, or failing to complete the required shots in time, their progress will be saved the next time the mission starts.

Shooting the spinner fills up the Energon cube on the display and the insert lights under the spinner. Once the cube is full, on the next mission start, using the flippers will make a choice on whether the next mission will be easier to complete but score less. Completing a mission without using the Energon cube will allow you to apply cosmic rust to the next mission, which makes it more difficult to complete but scores more per shot. The mission goals change based on the use of Energon and Rust. Collecting 3, then 6 Energon cubes will also qualify the spinner to start Stunt Loops.

The five missions are:

  • Autobot Run: Help the Autobots win a charity race. Make five blue arrow shots to light the final blow - two adjacent shots are lit at a time. Shooting quickly flashing blue shots scores 3x, in the following sequence: center spinner - left ramp - right orbit - left orbit - side ramp.
    • Energized: Shoot five blue arrows or targets to light final blow.
    • Rusted: Only one shot is lit to advance at a time (as listed above), and comboing them will score 4x.
  • Microbots: Shoot any ramp to light a drop target, missed drop targets unlight. Shooting further ramps increases the drop target multiplier and adds an additional lit drop target. Complete 3 lit drop targets to light final blow.
    • Energized: Shoot any shot to light drop targets, complete 3 lit drop targets to light final blow shot.
    • Rusted: Shoot left ramp to light a random drop target, missed targets unlight, complete 3 to light final blow shot. Right ramp increases the drop target multiplier, 1 time only.
  • Solar Needle: Deactivate the solar needle by hitting 2 lit cyan standup targets to light the captive ball. Additional cyan target hits increase captive ball value, red target hits reduce captive ball value. Hit 3 lit captive balls to light final blow shot.
    • Energized: Only requires 1 cyan target hit to light captive ball.
    • Rusted: Requires 3 cyan target hits to light captive ball. All major shots count as red and reduce the captive ball value.
  • Prime Target: Optimus has been captured by a hunter. Shoot the lit ramps and bash Optimus to increase shot value. Comboing ramps scores 2x the value. Make 6 lit ramps to light the final blow.
    • Energized:
    • Rusted: Shoot lit ramp, each combo is +1x. Shoot Optimus to build value and relight ramps.
  • Golden Lagoon: Lit yellow shots (ramps and VUK) add to spinner value, collect 25M from the spinner to light final blow shot. Spinner value begins at 60K/spin. Right orbit scores 2x the spinner value per spin.
    • Energized: Collect 10M to light final blow shot.
    • Rusted: Collect 60M to light final blow shot.

children.title: Dinobot Missions
children.html:
Shoot the Grimlock targets gating the left orbit to light the left orbit to start a Dinobot Mission. Complete each Dinobot Mission by scoring a total of 3 Dino Jackpots, lit at the left orbit after hitting the shots indicated on the right side of the display.

Scoring 3 Dino Jackpots during any mission lights the VUK to start Dinobot Desertion. If the player scored 3 Dino Jackpots in all 3 missions, the VUK will instead start Super Dinobot Desertion.

  • War: Hit the slingshots. Hit lit slingshots or bumpers to light jackpot. Only one slingshot or bumper is lit at a time. Jackpot can be increased with further lit slingshot / bumper hits.
  • Island: 2-ball multiball. Shoot 50 switches to light jackpot at the left orbit. Clear all major shots for add-a-ball (left ramp / center spinner, then right ramp gets added, then right orbit gets added, etc.)
  • S.O.S.: Objective-based mode. Hitting a drop target, standup target, orbit, pop bumper, or ramp will lock in that shot as the next one that needs to be hit repeatedly to light jackpot.

sections.title: Multiballs
sections.html: Add-A-Ball: Add-a-ball behaves uniquely on this machine compared to other Sterns of its era. Once per game, after the multiball ball save expires, the space bridge shot will be lit to add-a-ball and hold the ball in place for 10 seconds. Shooting the captive ball before time runs out will start 2x scoring for 30 seconds and release the ball, but the opportunity disappears once time runs out. Add-a-ball can be relit from a mystery award, and if the Bumblebee 2x scoring is brought into a multiball with add-a-ball enabled, shooting the held ball will boost the 2x scoring to 3x.

children.title: Transformers Multiball
children.html:
Shoot Optimus to light a lock, then shoot the center VUK to lock a ball. For subsequent multiballs, Optimus must be hit 4, 6, etc. times to light each lock. If lock is already lit, further Optimus shots will increase the jackpot value for the multiball by 250k. Lock 3 balls to start Transformers Multiball.

During multiball, the shots all start purple for Decepticon awards, then turn red for Autobot awards, then start flashing red / white to score jackpots. This means that shooting the same shot 3 times will score a jackpot there. Jackpots are multiplied by however many jackpots are currently lit (ie. a 4x jackpot would be scored if 4 jackpots are currently available). Collect three jackpots to light super jackpot at the side ramp, worth the combined base value of all prior jackpots.

children.title: Combiner Multiball
children.html:
Earn Combiner parts by shooting the side ramp. Each Combiner has five parts to collect; the color of qualified parts changes based on the most recent tech spec part scored. Combiner parts are also awarded after scoring 3 tech specs of the same color. Complete 3 Combiners to light the space bridge shot for Combiner Multiball, once no other modes are running. Completing Combiners also activates a [40-second timed super feature that differs with each Combiner.

Combiner Multiball starts by showing the player the Combiners they have completed. If they wish to delay the multiball, pressing the action button will skip the multiball and requalify it at the next Combiner completed.

During Combiner Multiball, shooting the spinner or holding the action button will cycle the grid of Combiners shown above the mission grid. If the player lands on a Combiner they completed, jackpots will light at the upper flipper shots, center spinner, Megatron, and right ramp. The base jackpot value starts at 6M (for 3 Combiners) and caps out at 10M (for 5 Combiners), but if the player lands on a Combiner they don’t have, the jackpot will reset to base value. The player can also increase the jackpot value by shooting white “build” shots while the spinner is active or the action button is held.

Score 2 jackpots in a wave to light the side ramp and space bridge shots for super jackpot worth 15M + 3M x jackpots scored, add-a-ball (based on the number of collected Combiners prior), and reset the process so another Combiner can be selected using the spinner or action button.

children.title: Autobot Hurry-Up
children.html:
Light the left inlane after completing the Megatron drop targets, and roll through the lit left inlane a total of 2 times without rolling through the lit right inlane to light this mode at the left ramp. Third+ hurry-ups require 4 lit left inlanes to be made.

3 shots are lit pink to collect the hurry-up value, which resets with each shot and starts at 15M: the right ramp, center spinner, and side ramp. The second time, these shots are at the left orbit, right orbit, and side ramp, and start at 25M. The mode ends once the value reaches its minimum or all 3 hurry-ups are scored.

children.title: Starscream Frenzy
children.html:
Light the right inlane after completing the Megatron drop targets, and roll through the lit right inlane a total of 2 times without rolling through the lit left inlane to light this mode at the right orbit. Third+ frenzies require 4 lit right inlanes to be made.

30 seconds of fast scoring are given while Starscream brags about being the new Decepticon leader. Every switch is worth 100k, and slingshots / bumpers are worth 500k, until time runs out. The scoring multiplier increases every time Starscream Frenzy is started.

children.title: Tech Specs, Action Button & Tech Spec Mania
children.html:
Shoot the standup targets near major shots to light the shots near them for Tech Specs. There are five colors of tech spec, one for each different Combiner. Tech Specs help spot combiner parts, and if a mission has been completed, will multiply all scores at the mission-specific shot if a Tech Spec is also scored there. Collect 15 tech specs of any color to light extra ball.

Making cassette combos will light the action button to temporarily light all shots for tech specs for 15 seconds.

Collect 3 tech specs of each color to instantly start Tech Spec Mania, so long as no other modes are running.

Tech Spec Mania is a 3-ball multiball where the player must collect one tech spec of every color. All major shots start out as one color, but will change colors with hits to the captive ball, and all shots award tech specs including qualifying Combiner parts if the player doesn’t have all 5 parts of the respective Combiner yet. Collecting one tech spec of every color (5 total) lights super jackpot at the side ramp, worth 10M + total tech specs x 1M x super jackpots collected this game, worth a base value of 25M. Each super jackpot scored also increases the value per tech spec collected during the multiball.

children.title: Bumblebee Double Scoring
children.html:
Shoot the lit captive ball to add letters to BUMBLEBEE. Three letters are added to BUMBLEBEE with every lit captive ball hit, so 3 lit captive balls will enable the next captive ball to start 30 seconds of 2x scoring. If the captive ball isn’t lit, hitting the bumper twice will relight the playfield X insert; and if the bumper isn’t lit, advance playfield X can be lit again from a mystery award.

If this form of double scoring is brought into any multiball where add-a-ball can be used, shooting the captive ball at the space bridge will start 3x scoring and reset the 30-second timer.

children.title: Combiner Super Features
children.html:
Once all five parts of a Combiner are collected, a 40-second timed super feature will instantly start. Multiple super features can run at the same time, and every new one started will reset the timer to its maximum of 40 seconds. The 5th Combiner completed in a game will always activate all 5 super features for 60 seconds in place of its normal super feature.

Super features can be activated at all times during play with one exception: if the player starts any mini-wizard mode, the super features will automatically end and cannot be progressed during the mode. Super features can be brought into, but not started during, Combiner Multiball.

The five super features and the Combiners they correspond to are:

  • Superion: Left, side, and right ramps score 10M.
  • Menasor: Spinner is worth 170k per spin.
  • Bruticus: All tech spec standup targets score 5M.
  • Defensor: Grimlock shot and right orbit score 15M.
  • Devastator: Drop targets and Megatron score 10M.

children.title: Stunt Loops
children.html:
Once the player has earned 3, then 6 Energon cubes by spinning the spinner enough times, the next shot to the spinner will start a 15-second timed Stunt Loops round.

The crash out jackpot starts at 5M, and every spin of the spinner adds 200k to the jackpot - which maxes out at 30M - and resets the timer. Shooting the side ramp increases the jackpot multiplier by +1x to a maximum of 4x. The jackpot can be scored at either the captive ball for its base value, or at the space bridge with an additional +2x jackpot multiplier. Therefore, the maximum value of the crash out jackpot is 180M. Collecting the jackpot or running out of time ends the mode. For the second round of Stunt Loops in a game, the jackpot caps out at 90M instead of 30M, meaning the maximum value becomes 540M.

Stunt Loops can be started at any time during play outside of when mini-wizard modes are running.

children.title: Mystery Award
children.html:
Repeatedly hit the bumper to light the mystery award at the space bridge shot, which can be hit with a late flip from the upper flipper. Mystery awards are dependent on game state.

Mystery awards include:

  • 5M
  • Light add-a-ball (if one has already been used)
  • Spot combiner part
  • Award 3 or 5 tech specs
  • Light bumper to advance playfield X (if playfield X has been activated already)
  • +4x bonus
  • +2x bonus (permanent)
  • Cyber Coin (IC exclusive; every 5th single-player game on standard play, the player can start a challenge mode following the end of normal play)

children.title: Cannon Jackpot (Prem / LE)
children.html:
At the start of each ball on Prem / LE models, the right ramp will be lit to load Megatron’s gun cannon. This shot scores 1M and fires the ball to the left flipper. Quickly hitting the right ramp afterwards will score a cannon combo award worth 5M, and fire the ball to the upper flipper. Hitting Optimus from this feed, either using the upper or lower flippers, will score a 14M cannon jackpot. The cannon can only be loaded this way once per ball, and only if no other modes are running.

The ball is also diverted to the cannon if the player completes Countdown to Extinction, and once One Shall Fall starts. In these cases, the cannon will fire to the left flipper.

children.title: Soundwave Modes
children.html:
Shoot the Cassette target 3 times to start the first Soundwave mode. Afterwards, cassette combos must be made to start subsequent Soundwave modes.

  • Interference: Shoot the roving blue arrows to increase the value of a hurry-up that can be scored at the Cassette target once the mode’s 20 second timer has run out.

children.title: Cassette Combos
children.html:
Rolling through the left inlane will briefly light the Cassette target to score a Cassette combo award. The combo score starts at 3M.

The player can chain together flashing white shots to increase the multiplier for the combo award. The maximum combo sequence is right ramp / scoop - left ramp - Cassette target for a 3-way Cassette combo.

Scoring a cassette combo qualifies the action button to light all tech specs, enabling 2x scoring at their shots for 15 seconds (however, once time expires, the tech specs will remain lit to collect). The number of cassette combos required to qualify the button increases by 1 each time the button is used.

children.title: Outlane Ball Saves / Countdown to Extinction
children.html:
• Left outlane: The left outlane ball save is lit at the start of the game. Once used, shoot the Soundwave target to relight it. The ball save can be relit twice per ball.
  • Right outlane: Countdown to Extinction is lit at the right outlane on the last ball of the game. If the player drains down the right outlane, they will have 18 seconds to shoot the right ramp to save their ball. The ball is held at the ramp diverter and releases to the upper flipper (fires to left flipper on Prem / LE).

children.title: Extra Balls
children.html:
Extra balls can be lit at the space bridge by:

  • Playing all 5 missions
  • Collecting 15 tech specs of any color

15M is scored in place of the extra ball if they are disabled or have been maxed out.

children.title: End-of-Ball Bonus
children.html:
Bonus is calculated by:

  • Base bonus
  • 500k x Dino Jackpots
  • 400k x Tech Specs
  • 1.5M x Energon Cubes

Bonus X only affects base bonus.

children.title: One Shall Fall (Mini-Wizard Mode)
children.html:
Light this mode at the right ramp after playing two missions. The player doesn’t have to start it; if they want, they can keep playing missions to make the mode more valuable / easier to win.

A duel between Optimus Prime and Megatron ensues. Shooting purple shots inflicts damage on Megatron and score 10% of the base value per shot. Avoid red shots, which inflict damage to Optimus Prime.

The base value for this mode is determined by:

  • 600k x Stored Energon Cubes
  • ??? x Rusted Missions started
  • ??? x Final Blows

Based on the modes the players started, perks are given that change the rules of the shots:

  • Autobot Run: Major shots no longer right red
  • Microbots: Purple drop targets are lit
  • Solar Needle: Red targets unlight after 2 hits
  • Prime Target: Drained balls no longer penalize
  • Golden Lagoon: Red slingshot is no longer lit

The final hurry-up lights at the Megatron scoop after enough purple shots, blocked by the drop targets. Get through the targets to the scoop to defeat Megatron before the hurry-up expires. Hitting white shots will increase the hurry-up by 10% of the maximum value, but watch out! Every “build” shot also resets the drop targets.

Win or lose, after the mode finishes, the flippers are disabled and all pinballs drain. A new ball will appear in the shooter lane with the skill shot disabled.

children.title: Rescue Optimus (Mini-Wizard Mode)
children.html:
Play all five missions to light the VUK to start Rescue Optimus, once no other modes are running.

This mini-wizard mode is played in 3 phases, each lasting 70 seconds. 30 seconds of ball save are given at the start of each phase.

  • Phase 1: Shoot Optimus to light sets of two shots. The shots disappear after being lit for about 15 seconds. Once four lit shots have been made, shoot the VUK to advance to the next phase.
  • Phase 2: The right flipper moves the lit arrow, while the left flipper moves the lit tech spec insert. Shooting a shot with a tech spec insert lit scores 1/2 the award, shooting a shot with an arrow lit scores the base award, but combining both scores 2.5x the award. This award can further be doubled by rolling through a lit inlane before hitting the lit shot. Score 4 lit shots of any type to light the VUK to advance to the next phase.
  • Phase 3: Multiball / victory laps - shoot unique jackpots to build the super jackpot at the space bridge. Shoot Optimus to re-light the jackpots.

children.title: Dinobot Desertion (Mini-Wizard Mode)
children.html:
Light Dinobot Desertion at the VUK by scoring 3 dino jackpots across any dinobot mission. If the player scored 3 dino jackpots in each mission, then the VUK will light to start Super Dinobot Desertion.

  • Phase One (60 seconds): Based on whatever Dinobot missions the player completed prior, and timed for 30 seconds + 15 seconds per Dinobot mission completed. War - slingshots will build the jackpot by 250k. Island - switches build the jackpot by 75k, spinner increases jackpot by 12k per spin. S.O.S. - shots / targets build the jackpot by 100k. Shoot the lit shots described above to build the jackpot. Shoot Megatron before time expires and without draining to triple the jackpot value.
  • Phase Two: The left orbit and Grimlock stand-up targets are lit. Stand-up targets score 0.5x the jackpot value. The left orbit scores 1x the jackpot value. Shooting the left orbit lights a combo to the side ramp or Optimus for a 2x jackpot, then right ramp for 2x jackpot, then the sequence repeats. Phase 2 lasts 30 seconds.
